newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trade in Kukdong shrs halted on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Kukdong shrs halted on Friday.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Friday it was halting trading in Kukdong City Gas Co shares for the day to punish the company for misinformation.

"The decision was made because of the company's insincere public announcement. The company reversed its earlier statement that denied major shareholder Chang Hong-son's stock sale to the LG Group," an exchange statement said.

A Kukdong statement said on Friday that LG Electronics Inc, a unit of the LG Group, had become the gas company's biggest shareholder after it bought a 23 percent stake from Chang and three other individuals.
Kukdong denied on March 10 that negotiations were underway between Chang and the LG Group on a stake sale.
Kukdong shares were last traded at 31,000 won.
